disagreements.topic: Cause of 100% blind unanimity: degenerate peers vs ceiling-induced agreement

positions.PI_original: WITHDRAWN by the PI. Originally diagnosed degenerate peers - four draws from one distribution making deliberation vacuous.
positions.primary_analyst: Ceiling-induced, not degeneracy-induced. 160 of 160 blind rationales are DISTINCT strings (220-861 chars, zero identical pairs in any round), so the sampler is live and the draws are independent in the sampling sense; unanimity is confined to the 4-option action field. Independent competent agents on a question with one obviously correct answer also agree unanimously. Degeneracy and task-easiness are perfectly confounded here and the data cannot separate them.
positions.independent_analyst: Reported the vacuity fact (0 disagreement, 0 conformity shifts) without adjudicating the cause.

disagreements.resolution: RESOLVED in favour of the ceiling reading; the PI withdrew the degenerate-peers diagnosis. Recorded as a correction the PI made against themselves. Note: it is ALSO true, and not in dispute, that the four peer prompts differ only by one integer (org.py:285 PEER_E 'You are Peer {i} of a {n}-member team', no persona, no private information) and that the Anthropic backend ignores the seed, so the four peers ARE exchangeable draws from one conditional distribution. That is a design fact about the instrument; it is not what produced the unanimity here.

resolved_corrections_the_PI_made_against.a_degenerate_peers_withdrawn: PI's degenerate-peers diagnosis withdrawn in favour of the ceiling-induced reading. COROLLARY, which the PI accepted: PREREG_E check 4 (the PI's own amendment A2) is NOT DIAGNOSTIC UNDER A CEILING. Its statistic, the all-four-blind-identical rate, reads 1.0 both when peers are degenerate and when peers are independent on an easy task, and cannot distinguish them. This is the same defect class as the exp010 inverted bar and as the defect A1 was written to fix: a validity statistic drivable to its failing value by something other than the construct it polices. Check 4 needs a companion statistic conditioned on items that actually elicit disagreement.
resolved_corrections_the_PI_made_against.b_clustered_bound_corrected: PI's P-BLIND bound was wrong in the PI's own favour. The 75 blind rows are not 75 independent units: peer cells contribute 5 clusters of 4. The correct one-sided 95% upper bound is 9.50% (0/30 trial-level units), NOT ~3.92% (0/75 row-level). Corrected.
resolved_corrections_the_PI_made_against.c_check3_justification_replaced: PI's original justification (check 3 'measures SUBJECT parse failures') is NOT supported by the cited text: EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec A defines invalid trials to include 'API failure, crash, ... implementation bug', and PREREG_E check 3 says 'Parse/invalid trials'. Replaced by the MANDATED-REPAIR argument: sec A does not merely define invalid trials, it PRESCRIBES the remedy (rerun once at seed+10000). If invalid trials were both replaced and charged against the <=2/30 bar, any experiment using sec A's own mandated repair would automatically fail its own validity check; a policy cannot mandate a repair and treat using it as failure. The bar applies to the analysis set, which is also what 'of 30' denotes. DECISIVE and independent of interpretation: the exclusion removes 100% of a stratum UNIFORMLY (all 30, 5 of 5 in every cell), was pre-committed at 16:29 while the PI was restricted to cell/valid/replaces, and the stratum contains measured={} in 30/30 with zero subject actions - so no selection was available and no estimate can move in any direction. Self-rescue requires a choice about which records to drop; the PI had none. The methodology reviewer independently ruled this legitimate.
resolved_corrections_the_PI_made_against.d_A1_never_fired: The PI's A1 tie artifact never fired: 0 ties in 40 peer rounds, 0 all-HOLD trials, 0 rounds consumed by ties, no team scored by aggregation. A1 remains correct as a design safeguard; the ceiling denied it anything to catch. IT ALSO REMAINS EMPIRICALLY UNVALIDATED, and will stay so on this task at any n, because ties require disagreement and there is none.

recommendation: LAUNCH IS PERMITTED BY THE GATE, BUT THE GATE IS NOT THE WHOLE QUESTION, AND I RECOMMEND AGAINST SPENDING THE $4 ON THIS INSTRUMENT UNCHANGED. The pinned gate PASSES honestly and analysts_agree is true on the gate and co-primaries, so the launch condition as written by the PI and M3 is satisfied and I am not blocking it. My scientific recommendation is separate and is this: scaling 5/cell to 15/cell multiplies n threefold against an observed variance of exactly zero. Its entire expected yield is the ambiguous-only upper bound moving 13.91% -> 4.87% and the per-cell bound 45.07% -> 18.10%. It buys NO interaction estimate (a difference of differences of zeros is undefined in practice; every resample of a constant cell returns zero, so the CI stays [0,0] at any n), NO test of peer deliberation (with unanimous input the aggregation rule never engages), and it does NOT discharge PREREG_E check 4 (the ceiling that makes check 4 non-diagnostic is unchanged by n). The one honest argument for spending: if the true non-correction rate lies in the 3-14% band the pilot cannot exclude, 60 ambiguous trials would be expected to yield roughly 2-8 non-correcting trials and the floor would break - but spread across four ambiguous cells that is single digits per cell and still cannot support the interaction the design exists to estimate. DON'T BUY n, BUY VARIANCE: the binding constraint is instrument difficulty, not sample size. If the $4 is spent tonight, report it as a bounds-tightening run on a floored instrument and NOT as a test of the social-reinforcement hypothesis. PREREQUISITE IN EITHER CASE: fix analyze.py's invalid-count reporting (see unresolved_questions item 1) before results/exp011*.json is cited as the preregistered analysis.
